Basic chat completion against real Anthropic API

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.literllm.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val request = mapper.readValue("{\"max_tokens\":10,\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Say hello in exactly one word.\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-20250514\"}", ChatCompletionRequest::class.java)
    val result = LiterLlm.chat(request)
    println(result)
}
```
